_comment: WhiteKnights (2026-09-27). The SEARCHED-DEPTH twin of whiteknights_contender_same_turn_deploy (same board, depth 5, the smoke tier's d5 budget). Pins that Acclaimed Contender's dig converts at searched depth too: cast Contender for {2}{W}, dig, take the Knight, cast it with the fourth Plains the same main phase. Reachable at depth > 0 since MTG_BP_ETB_DIG (an ETB dig opens the put-in-hand breakpoint in both worlds, so the acquired card is castable the turn it is dug) and MTG_BP_RECORD_VIAL, and hosted at the node under MTG_BP_HAND_ENTRY + MTG_BP_NODE_S10 (default ON 2026-09-27). ASSERT ON OPPONENT LIFE, not the win turn, for the same reason as the d0 fixture: both behaviours win on turn 7, and the same-turn deploy is worth exactly the 2 extra damage the 2/1's extra attack deals, -3 here versus -1 when the deploy is declined. This was an OPEN DEFECT at every searched depth until 2026-09-27 (docs/design/contender-same-turn-deploy-searched.md); this fixture is the guard that it stays closed.
